content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Adult postsecondary degree programs for military and working learners, not K-12 public school programs or curriculum."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Payroll, HR and tax outsourcing for employers; no education business in common."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Nonprofit fundraising and school administration software; it does not sell curriculum or instruction to students."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced enrollment marketing and operations for one private university, not K-12 instruction or curriculum."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Sells K-12 digital curriculum, courseware and learning platforms to school districts and state agencies, matching Stride's core offering."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Cloud HR and payroll software for employers; a different business altogether."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Degree programs for adult learners paying tuition; no K-12 public school or curriculum business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Adult working-learner degree programs funded by tuition; not K-12 virtual schooling or public school contracts."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Corporate and government workforce skills training sold to enterprises; not K-12 education."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Hands-on campus trade training for students paying tuition; differs from Stride's K-12 virtual school and online curriculum."}]}
